fusions.name: Lulling Venom
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of venom that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Take-Off Tangle
fusions.desc: Beats the air in a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 11 damage to everything in it, knocks each enemy back 3 tiles and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Beads and Sheds
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Raft Walker
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
